adds.name: Trinidad Lake State Park (South Shore)
adds.waterfront_evidence: Esri imagery 2025-11-02 (Wayback release 63116, 0.34 m) with all 10 cpwshop site GIS points plotted: the sites string along a gravel road at the foot of the south-shore hill; open grass slopes down ~160 m to the park's south-shore road, the high-water edge lies just past it (~170-200 m) and the Nov 2025 waterline ~300 m out, no treeline between, so the lake is in view but well past the ~50 m bound and across a road (lakeview, not lakefront). Dam 1.1 km NE; the sites are on the reservoir side at DEM ~1895-1901 m vs ~1886 m on the open water, so not below pool.
adds.inclusion_evidence: cpwshop.com (parkID 50044) sells 10 South Shore sites (101-110, 108HA ADA), all 'Basic' with 'Looking For Category: RV Site,Tent Site,Trailer Site', gravel driveways and Maximum Vehicle Length 30-100 ft (4 pull-throughs at 80-100 ft); CPW's camping page and brochure name 'The 10-site South Shore Campground' as one of the park's two campgrounds -> real drive-in RV campground a 23-ft motorhome fits.
adds.note: Trinidad Lake State Park's second campground, on the south shore about 1.7 km across the lake from Carpios Ridge and reached by its own gravel road along the south shore from the dam end rather than through the Carpios Ridge entrance. The sites, each with a picnic shelter, sit on open grass at the foot of a pinon-juniper hill looking north over the lake. --Claude

sites.note: 10 basic sites (101-110, 108HA accessible): 6 back-ins listed for vehicles to 30 ft and 4 pull-throughs (101 and 110 at 100 ft, 105 and 106 at 80 ft), so all 10 take a 23-ft rig.

facilities.note: A community water hydrant and vault toilets; the showers, laundry and flush toilets are in the camper-services building at Carpios Ridge, and the dump station is near the Carpios Ridge entrance.

season.note: CPW's camping page gives May 1 - October 15, and elsewhere on the same page says the campground is closed between mid-October and mid-May.

booking.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people and one camper/RV plus one tent per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

fees.note: Every South Shore site is basic: $28 a night, Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a vehicle pass ($4 a day to $80 a year per CPW's park page) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

excluded.name: Trinidad Lake State Park (Piedmont group camping area)
excluded.reason: Group-only: cpwshop parkID 50044 sells it as one 'Group Camping' site ('Piedmont Group Site', 37.1421,-104.5446); CPW: 'Group camping is available at the Piedmont group camping area'. The park's only other camping is Carpios Ridge (entry 2261) and South Shore (added), per cpwshop's 65 + 10 + 1 sites and CPW's '73 campsites across two campgrounds'.
